tooltips.hideHUDTip: Hide the recording bar. Show it again from the taskbar or the tray icon.
tooltips.restartRecording: Delete this recording and start a new one
tooltips.systemAudio: System audio: records the sound your computer plays
tooltips.camera: Camera: records you as a separate layer you can move in the editor
tooltips.openStudio: Open Studio: the editor for your recordings
tooltips.openNotes: Open Notes: text to read while you record

notesToolbar.mirrorTip: Flip the text left to right, to read it in a mirror

tooltips.confirmDiscardRecording: Click again to discard this recording

cursor.name: Editable cursor
cursor.editableTip: Editable cursor: recorded separately, so you can restyle it and auto-zoom in the editor
cursor.systemTip: System cursor: your real cursor, recorded in the video. No restyling, no auto-zoom.

sourceSelector.emptyDescription: If you just granted screen recording permission, reload this picker. On macOS you may need to reopen OpenScreen.
sourceSelector.loadFailedDescription: OpenScreen couldn't load your screens and windows. Reload this picker and try again.

recording.selectSource: Choose a screen or window to record
recording.systemPicker: Your system will ask what to share

cameraLayout.name: Face: only the camera
cameraLayout.faceTip: Face: only the camera, full screen. Click to show the screen with the camera.
cameraLayout.screenTip: Screen + camera: your screen, with the camera in a corner. Click to show only the camera, full screen.

drawing.startTip: Draw on the screen: pen, arrow, shapes and highlighter. The strokes are in the video. Esc leaves.
drawing.stopTip: Stop drawing (Esc). What you drew fades out on its own.
drawing.fadeAfter: Strokes fade after {{seconds}} s. Click to change.
drawing.fadeNever: Strokes stay until cleared. Click to change.
drawing.windowCaptureNote: You are recording a window: Windows records only that window's pixels, so these strokes do NOT go into the video. To record them, record the screen.

selfView.name: See the camera
selfView.showTip: See the camera: a small floating window with your camera, for you only. It never goes into the video.
selfView.windowTip: Only you see this: it is not recorded. Drag to move, scroll to resize.

micSilent.title: Your microphone seems muted
micSilent.description: No sound from the microphone for a few seconds. Check that it is not muted (on the device or in Windows) and that the right input is picked.

systemLanguagePrompt.title: Use your system language?
systemLanguagePrompt.description: We detected {{language}} as your system language. Do you want to switch OpenScreen to {{language}}?

softwareEncoderFallback.title: Switched to a backup encoder
softwareEncoderFallback.description: Your graphics card's encoder didn't start, so OpenScreen switched to a backup. Your recording is fine, though your computer may work a little harder.

deviceSettings.title: Device settings
deviceSettings.broadcastTip: Tip: pick the "NVIDIA Broadcast" microphone to have background noise removed.
deviceSettings.micSilenceWarning: Warn if the microphone seems muted

permissions.title: OpenScreen needs a few permissions
permissions.subtitle: macOS asks you to grant each one once. You can change them at any time in System Settings.

screen.name: Screen & system audio
screen.description: To record your screen and the sound your Mac plays.

systemAudio.name: System audio
systemAudio.description: To record the sound your Mac plays. Choosing a screen or window needs no permission.

accessibility.name: Accessibility
accessibility.description: To show the right cursor (pointer, text) in your recordings.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: To add your webcam to your recordings.

help.screenPrompt: macOS will then ask you to turn on OpenScreen in System Settings.
help.screenSettings: In System Settings, turn on OpenScreen. If macOS offers to quit and reopen it, accept: this window will come back.
help.screenNotListed: OpenScreen isn't in the list? Click +, then choose OpenScreen in Applications.
help.screenRestart: Allowed. OpenScreen needs to restart before it can use it.
help.screenRecurring: On your first recording, macOS will ask whether OpenScreen may access your screen directly, without the system picker. Click Allow. macOS asks again from time to time; that's expected.
help.systemAudioPrompt: macOS will ask you to allow OpenScreen to record the sound your Mac plays.
help.systemAudioRequested: If you said no, turn on OpenScreen under “System Audio Recording Only” in System Settings.

footer.screenRequired: Screen recording is needed to record.

headphonesHint.title: Use headphones
headphonesHint.body: With the microphone and the computer sound both on, the speakers' sound reaches the microphone. Headphones keep it out (the editor can also remove that echo later).
